title: Best Tour in Barcelona
text: This excursion is a must!  Have taken this tour 3 times at night. Absolutely awe inspiring.  Going places others cannot go. Driver, Pablo, is great and excellent American English
author: RONALD_B

title: Book it, book it, book it!
text: This was incredible, so much so that I still think about the experience over a year later. It’s truly a unique way to see Barcelona. Our guides were very knowledgeable and funny. It was a one of a kind experience and I’d do it a thousand times over.
author: Amanda_k

title: Cool Ride
text: We had a wonderful sunset tour and our guide was super cool. It sure beat the double decker bus tour. The cost was worth it.
author: yoeme210

title: Loved it, highly recommend!
text: So glad me and my daughter did this, great fun and we saw so much of Barcelona.  The 8pm trip was nice and cool and the evening views were amazing.  Thanks Joppe!
author: N7238NTjoannah

title: Surprisingly awesome!
text:
We were looking for something a little different that would also be friendly for mobility-challenged seniors. We wanted an evening activity when the weather was cooler, and we came across this sidecar tour. At first, my parents were a little hesitant, but they quickly warmed up to the idea—and by the end, they absolutely loved it.

Our guides, Matthias and Joppe, were fantastic. The sidecars were surprisingly comfortable for both my mother and my mother-in-law, and they felt safe and well taken care of throughout the ride.

author: Lisa_B

title: Great way to see the city
text: The perfect way to see the city. Our guide Stephen was knowledgeable and funny. This was my first time in a motorcycle and I road in the sidecar and felt perfectly safe.  The best part of a tour like this is the one on one time with a local person. Gives such an intimate view of the city.  I would suggest taking this tour at the start of your visit to set up your plans.
author: Mary_R

title: Book this ASAP!
text: You have found the best tour - book it now!  Had one night in Barcelona before a cruise and could not see it all - but we did!  Surprised my mother with this experience.  As we were waiting in the lobby of our hotel I told other guests what we were going to do and they waited to see my mom’s reaction to what was in store.  Our driver Stephen drove up and people outside circled around and lobby guests went outside as they were excited (and a little jealous) that they did not book this. author: J5004VKheathere

title: Night Tour of Barcelona by Sidecar Motorcycle
text: Marvellous experience for celebrating our 41st anniversary. Our guide Johannes is humorous and knowledgeable. He is also very considerate. He first understood from us which places that we have already visited and what particular places that we would wish to go. He then gave us some additional advice and designed the 2 and a half hour night trip for us. He provided detailed background of our visited places which gave us  better understanding. Highly recommended especially Johannes to you all.
author: Mobile11301274962

title: Great experience
text: Johanes was the best guide. So much fun and great way to see the city. Such a fun experience and so different!!  Johanes was such a nice guy with so much history to inform us with.
author: levisoncathy

title: Night tour in Barcelona
text:
We took a lot of tours in Barcelona, and this was one of our favorites. We saw the action of Barcelona at night with all the lights and less traffic…and it was spectacular. We enjoyed feeling like a local and riding around on a motorbike and the sidecar.
Pablo was our guide for the evening and he was so knowledgeable about the city and has also been all over the world doing excursions and tours on his cycle and so we knew we’re in great hands with safety!
author: Valery18
